newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was very slow late Monday. There were not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for a market test at the close.
Inquiry was good, demand was light. Sales confirmed on 100 slaughter steers and 100 slaughter heifers. For the week to date 4,500 head confirmed, mostly previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Steers - pen select and choice 2-3 1200 lbs 66.00.
Heifers - pen select and choice 2-3 1000 lbs 66.00.
